# MarkovProcess consumer pilot

> A small Lean 4 project built on Scott Armstrong's MarkovProcess library (https://github.com/scottnarmstrong/MarkovProcess), which supplies the Brownian motion, exit times, heat generator, optional stopping and Dynkin's formula. The pilot adds about 250 lines. Headline theorem `MarkovProcessPilot.integral_eval_exitTimeTrunc_Ioo`: for `a < x < b` and every `K : ℝ≥0`, the integral of `ω (exitTimeTrunc (Set.Ioo a b) K ω)` against `MarkovProcess.brownianMotion x` equals `x`. Bridge `MarkovProcessPilot.isBrownianReal_iff`: `MarkovProcess.IsBrownianReal X P ↔ ProbabilityTheory.IsBrownianReal X P` for every `X` and `P`. The exit time is truncated at `K`; untruncated exit times and the exit probability are not proved. Lean `v4.35.0-rc2`, Mathlib `065356127b1d`, MarkovProcess `666cda029098`. Lower-tier and comparator receipts (made with lean-pkg 0.14.0; comparator toolchain mechanism, con-ron, NanoDa and Lean kernels) are bound to commit `1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276`; every reusable claim is judged by a Mathlib-only comparator Challenge named by `judged_as` in claims.yaml. This is a pilot, not a general library; credit MarkovProcess for the underlying theory.

## Essential

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/main/README.md): Result, scope, status and quick start.
- [Repository contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/main/AGENTS.md): Which files are bound to receipts, and the rules for changes.
- [Machine-readable claims](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/main/claims.yaml): The two claimed theorems (schema claims/1).
- [Proof outline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/main/docs/proof-outline.md): Dynkin's formula route, the comparator statement, and what came from MarkovProcess.

## Source at the receipted commit

- [BrownianExit.lean](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/MarkovProcessPilot/BrownianExit.lean): The bridge, the test function and the exit-time theorem.
- [Comparator challenge](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/Audit/Exit/Challenge.lean): Theorem `exit_mean`, stated with Mathlib only.
- [Comparator solution](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/Audit/Exit/Solution.lean): Proves `exit_mean` from the pilot theorem.
- [Bridge comparator challenge](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/Audit/BrownianKernel/Challenge.lean): Theorem `exists_unique_brownian_kernel`, Mathlib only: exactly one Markov kernel is Brownian at every starting point (stronger than the bridge claim, since Mathlib cannot name the library's kernel).
- [Bridge comparator solution](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/Audit/BrownianKernel/Solution.lean): Proves it with `MarkovProcess.brownianMotion` as the witness.
- [lakefile.toml](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276/lakefile.toml): Single `require` on MarkovProcess at a pinned commit.

- [Reproducing and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/main/docs/reproducing.md): Pins, build commands, build cost, axioms and receipts.
- [Comparator receipt](https://github.com/chenle02/markovprocess-pilot/blob/main/.lean-receipts/1548828e63c8-comparator.json): Result `pass` for `exit_mean`, `exists_unique_brownian_kernel` and the smoke test.
